}

<?php
class ReviewRestEarlier07 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewRestCurrent07 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
class ReviewRestMixedIterator07 implements Iterator {
    public $earlier; public $current; public $position = 0;
    function __construct() { $this->earlier = [new ReviewRestEarlier07]; $this->current = new ReviewRestCurrent07; }
    function __destruct() { echo "I|"; }
    function rewind(): void { echo "W|"; }
    function valid(): bool { echo "V|"; return $this->position < 2; }
    function &current(): mixed { echo "C|"; if ($this->position === 0) { return $this->earlier; } return $this->current; }
    function key(): mixed { echo "K|"; return $this->position; }
    function next(): void { echo "X|"; $this->position++; }
}
function reviewRestUnset07($head, &...$items) { echo "D|"; unset($items); echo "REST|"; unset($head); echo "HEAD|"; }
set_error_handler(function($l, $m, $f, $line) { echo "H", $l, ":", $m, "@", $line, "|"; return true; });
reviewRestUnset07(...new ReviewRestMixedIterator07);
echo "E";
purpose: An earlier BYVALUE array and later variadic object retain separate owners: unset(rest) leaves the original EXTRA private cell alive; unset(head) retires A before HEAD, and B survives until frame cleanup.
